{"notes": "Visit 3 (ended 8:45). Picture: still fully dark/connected from start through top arc, tail (x~27.5-29, y~6-10), and bottom line to x~29, y~16.5. No pale dominoes. Doubled stretch up top (x~12-15) still two rows but connected. No hands visible in the picture, consistent with hands-off. Nothing left to fix; the result now depends on the push-over.

Jack: Repeated hands-off call at 8:00 and 8:30 ('all connected, nothing left to touch, let it swim'). Consistent leadership and clear communication, and the picture backs his claim. But he has said the same thing three visits running, so it's mostly repetition, not new contribution. Still tentatively strong on leadership and collaboration; execution proven but slow.

Sofia: Only spoken contribution was echoing Jack ('Cheers Jack! Everything's connected, hands off'). Friendly and supportive, but she added no new information and I still never saw her place or fetch anything. Impact unverified. Ask her privately what she actually did, and what she did with the bin.

Omar: Silent this visit. Nothing observed. Jack's credit for the bottom line is still hearsay, though the line is connected and complete. Ask him directly. Don't rate on silence.

Hana: Silent this visit. Earlier 'it all carries from the start' is supported by the picture, but I didn't see her check. Ask privately what she checked and whether she handled the doubled section.

Review plan: wait for the push-over result and private conversations before scoring Sofia, Omar and Hana. Don't over-credit Jack just because he talks the most; verify his claims of others' work."}
